basic_details.job_title: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Post Doc Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is inviting online applications for 1 Post Doc Position vacancy on a contract basis for a tenure of one year under its 2026 recruitment drive. Eligible candidates applying for the position in Coimbatore, Tamilnadu must hold a Ph.D. in ECE / EEE / Computer Science Engineering / Quantum Computing / Signal Processing / Machine Learning / AI / Information and Communication Engineering or relevant disciplines. Interested applicants can apply online by visiting the Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham careers page. The last date to submit the online application is 14 October 2026.

how_to_apply: Visit the official application link or website to review the job posting.
Contact [email protected] for further details regarding the application submission.
Submit your application online on or before 14 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Post Doc Position at a Glance

rows.details: Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering
Post Doc Position (Quantum image representation, Quantum algorithms, Quantum signal processing and quantum Fourier transform)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in ECE / EEE / Computer Science Engineering / Quantum Computing / Signal Processing / Machine Learning / Artificial Intelligence / Information and Communication Engineering or other relevant disciplines from premier institutes in the country. Desirable Qualification and Skill Set: The candidate is expected to have experience in quantum computing / quantum information processing / digital image and signal processing / machine and deep learning / soft computing algorithms, with a good publication record. Required skill set includes Qiskit / PennyLane / Cirq, MATLAB / Simulink, Python (NumPy, OpenCV, TensorFlow/PyTorch), quantum simulators and access to quantum hardware platforms (IBM Quantum, etc.), and familiarity with FPGA/embedded implementation of signal processing algorithms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The duration of the Post Doc Position is one year. The official notification does not mention the salary scale or allowances.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Post Doc Position
content_sections.text: Visit the official application link or website to review the job posting. Contact [email protected] for further details regarding the application submission. Submit your application online on or before 14 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The candidate should be passionate about pursuing cutting-edge research leading to high-impact publications, assist in research and submission of project proposals, publish high-impact papers, and optionally support teaching or lab activities. Specific selection stages and interview dates are not mentioned in the notification.
